guide.setup: Place hands slightly wider than the shoulders and step into a straight plank with abs and glutes braced.
guide.execution: Lower the chest between the hands with elbows at a comfortable angle, then press the floor away to straight arms.
guide.cues: Move as one plank. Keep the neck neutral. Push the floor away.
guide.mistakes: Sagging or piking hips; flaring elbows to 90 degrees; cutting the range short; leading with the head.
